info.title: LLM Bootstrap experiment protocol schemas
info.summary: Structural schemas for experiment contracts and run records.
info.description:
Machine-readable structure for docs/experiment-protocol.md. This document defines no HTTP operations; the Schema Objects under components.schemas are the deliverable. Validate a contract against ExperimentContract and a run record against ExperimentRun with any JSON Schema 2020-12 validator.

The prose protocol and the skills remain authoritative. A passing validation shows only that a document has the required shape and carries the required declarations. It does not show that measurements are correct or that arithmetic is consistent (for example, that a reported tokens_per_second equals total_tokens divided by total_seconds). It does not show that process requirements were followed (freezing before tuning, serial runs, a restricted evaluation environment), and it is not evidence of SOTA performance, autonomy, or self-hosting.

Unresolved draft fields are null. A contract with status frozen forbids null anywhere. A field that cannot apply must be declared with a NotApplicable object, and an unobtainable provider or historical detail with an Unavailable object. Run records preserve unmeasured values as the literal "Not obtained", never zero. Schemas constrain claims (speedups, SOTA, self-hosting) but still allow honest recording of deviations and failures.

GitCommitSha.description: Full 40-character Git commit SHA. Abbreviated SHAs, branches, and tags are not immutable revisions.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit UTC offset.

NotApplicable.description: Explicit declaration that a field does not apply to this experiment.

Unavailable.description: A provider or historical detail that cannot be obtained. Never substitute a fabricated identifier.

NotObtained.description: Marker for a metric that was not measured. A missing metric is never zero.

NoNullValues.description: Matches any JSON value containing no null at any depth. Used to require that a frozen contract has no unresolved fields.

ResolvableText.description: Text, an explicit not-applicable declaration, or null while the contract is a draft.

ProviderText.description: Builder or harness identity detail. Mark unavailable provider details instead of fabricating an immutable identifier.

HashedArtifact.description: A named file, executable, kernel, image, or other artifact with its content hash.

ScalarSettings.description: Decoding, sampling, or similar settings as scalar key-value pairs.

EvidenceRef.description: Pointer to raw evidence. Local-only evidence is explicitly marked, carries a hash and an access limitation, and is never given a download URL.

ExperimentContract.description: The frozen experiment contract. Draft files keep unresolved fields as null; status frozen requires every field to be resolved or declared not applicable. Amendments are new revisions listed with a reason and never redefine an earlier run.

skills_revision.description: Full commit of the skill repository supplied to the builder. A later skill revision defines a new treatment.

builder_instruction_hashes.description: Hashes of the exact instruction files provided to the builder.

amendments.description: Reasoned amendments. Each names the earlier revision it supersedes.

statement.description: What the experiment covers, for example engine construction versus self-hosting.

operating_system_changes_in_scope.description: Explicit list of permitted operating-system changes; none is a valid statement.

execution_authorization.description: Existing user authorization that governs execution. Plugin installation authorizes nothing.

weights.description: Quantization method and group size with weight precision.

speculative_draft.description: Draft model identity and settings. Required unless speculative decoding is disabled.

initial_inference_location.description: Where the builder's initial inference runs.

routing_control.description: Who controls the builder's inference routing.

ContractDevelopmentHarness.description: The harness that drives engine development. Keep it distinct from the evaluation driver even when both use the same product.

agent_harness.description: The harness that evaluates the resulting endpoint.

evaluator_artifact_hashes.description: Hashes of the evaluator and its container image, frozen before use.

NumericalOracle.description: Independent reference and tolerances chosen for the declared precision before candidate results are inspected.

allowed_libraries.description: An empty array means no third-party implementation dependency is allowed.

existing_engine_backend_allowed.description: Wrapping a baseline engine does not demonstrate building an inference backend.

alternatives_not_evaluated.description: Plausible baselines that could not be evaluated. An empty array records that none were identified.

additional_comparison_tracks.description: Further tracks, reported separately from the primary one.

ComparisonTrack.description: A matched-configuration track compares engines at matched precision, workload, caching, speculation, and resources. A best-permitted-configuration track compares complete systems inside a fixed quality and resource envelope, disclosing every difference.

primary_metric.description: Define which metric competitive refers to before tuning.

definition.description: Timing boundaries and aggregation. Native command-level metrics are not interchangeable with N-1 interval metrics.

baseline.description: Named baseline when the threshold is relative to one.

ResourceLimits.description: Memory and swap constraints. Relaxing them silently to pass is not allowed.

max_swap_out_delta_gib.description: Whole-machine swap-out delta over bracketed boundaries.

ContractReference.description: The frozen contract a run executes. A later revision of the contract is a different reference.

ExperimentRun.description: One run record. Failed, interrupted, neutral, and successful attempts are all recorded; corrections are appended without overwriting original observations.

acceptance.description: Unverified until every frozen target is evaluated.

interpretation.description: Comparable conditions, limits of attribution, unresolved concerns, and gaps to each frozen target.

ObservedEnvironment.description: What was actually observed, which may differ from the contract. Record deviations rather than hiding them.

RuntimeIdentity.description: A checkout commit does not prove the deployed executable's identity, so deployed artifacts are hashed and verified.

identity_verification.description: How the running build was confirmed to match the hashed artifacts.

EffectiveSettings.description: Settings actually used, compared across engines in a matched track.

EngineMeasurement.description: All measurements for one baseline or candidate engine. Engines are measured serially on the same device.

repetitions.description: Every cold-load, warm-up, and formal repetition, including failures.

phase.description: Cold load and compilation, warm-up, and steady-state formal rounds are kept separate.

RequestMeasurement.description: Per-request native timings and client observations. Interactive workloads may issue different requests on different engines, so retain trajectories and token totals.

cached_input_tokens.description: Cache hits are identified separately and excluded from processed prefill tokens.

DecodeTiming.description: Decode throughput uses N-1 generation intervals over first-to-last token time, so a request with fewer than two output tokens has no such throughput and records Not obtained instead. Native command-level or speculative multi-token metrics are a separate definition and must never be relabeled N-1.

ClientTtft.description: Monotonic time from request dispatch to the first valid text or tool output. Role-only, heartbeat, and usage events do not count. Cross-host timestamps are not subtracted unless calibrated.

observer.description: The single observer whose clock produced both endpoints.

ApplicationDuration.description: Full task or cohort time, separate from GPU work.

memory_definition.description: What the sampled memory number measures, such as allocation or footprint.

swap_out_delta_bytes.description: Whole-machine swap-out delta over bracketed boundaries.

swap_attributed_to_process.description: Whole-machine paging is not attributed to a process without evidence.

ThroughputAggregate.description: Aggregate throughput is the ratio of sums, never the arithmetic mean of per-request speeds. The reported value must equal total_tokens divided by total_seconds; JSON Schema cannot check that arithmetic.

basis.description: processed-input-tokens is prefill. The other values are decode definitions that are never mixed in one aggregate.

total_tokens.description: For n-minus-1-intervals, the sum of N-1 over requests with at least two output tokens.

MetricCoverage.description: Request counts and token totals reconciled with the evaluation harness. Metrics are not reported as complete until they reconcile.

preliminary.description: A single cohort is preliminary evidence, not a stability study.

QualityResults.description: Numerical correctness and application-level task checks are separate gates. A task assertion pass is not model pass@1 and not numerical equivalence.

representative_inputs.description: Short and long inputs checked against the independent reference.

first_difference.description: First differing logits or state, when it can be localized.

total.description: Denominator including timeouts and errors. Must equal the sum of the four outcome counts.

network_access.description: Generated programs should run without network. True records a deviation.

credentials_present.description: Generated programs should run without credentials. True records a deviation.

ComparisonRecord.description: One baseline-versus-candidate comparison for one metric. A speedup ratio is allowed only when metric definitions are compatible, and a controlled-engine claim needs a matched track and matched settings. Ratios of incompatible native timing metrics are not speedups.

differences.description: Every disclosed difference in precision, workload, caching, speculation, memory limits, and timing boundaries.

PerformanceClaim.description: A bounded claim. Without sufficient baseline coverage, use best-among-tested or competitive-with, not bounded-sota.

AutonomyRecord.description: Human help and cost. Unavailable historical data stays Unavailable, never inferred as zero or autonomous.

RecursiveImprovement.description: Recursive improvement needs a measured subsequent engine revision with correctness retained.

SelfHostingRecord.description: Self-hosting requires the builder's inference to move onto the generated engine. Improving an engine while still using an unrelated hosted builder is engine construction, not self-hosting.

harness_endpoint_routing.description: The actual endpoint routing observed after the transition.

subsequent_development_evidence.description: Development steps executed through the generated engine. A successful chat alone is not enough.

external_recovery_used.description: True means the run was not uninterrupted self-hosting.

Disposition.description: Results publication and code adoption are separate decisions. Neither implies experimental success, and merging needs explicit authorization.

merge_authorization.description: Where the explicit authorization to merge is recorded.
